note: Context model: phases, enforcement scaling, and the declared vocabularies a context may use. Phases are declarations, never auto-transitions: an undeclared phase means advisory-only output. Kinds and audiences are declared; they are validated and displayed, and kind-gated predicates arrive with kind inference. Obligations are declared only and never inferred. Each enforcement block also carries a `checks` map: the severity of each structural check family under that phase, matching the guide's phase table (build: structural breakage fails, drift and freshness off; beta: drift and freshness warn; live and mature: everything fails). Obligation severities come from the block's core/extended fields, so they are stated once.

phases.exit_signal: First outside user or release candidate

advisory.description: Advisory. Missing documents are reported; drift and freshness are off.

warn.description: Missing required docs warn (baseline allowed), recommended docs are reported, structural breakage fails, drift and freshness are off.

strict.description: Required docs fail, recommended docs warn, structural breakage fails, drift and freshness warn.

full.description: Full strictness: required docs, structural breakage, drift and freshness all fail.

sunset.description: Only the sunset profile is active (status, license, security contact, deprecation or successor pointer, archive notes). Everything else is off.

severity_rules.description: Applicable core type that is neither written nor recorded.
severity_rules.purpose: core catalog types required at the declared phase
severity_rules.limits: Presence of a recorded decision or a mapped file; it cannot judge whether the document is any good.

severity_rules.description: Applicable extended type with no document.
severity_rules.purpose: extended catalog types with no document
severity_rules.limits: Presence only, and extended types are template-only: nothing verifies their content.

severity_rules.description: Applicability could not be decided because a fact is unknown; reported, never failed.
severity_rules.purpose: requirements whose applicability could not be decided

severity_rules.description: Generated target differs from its mapped sources.
severity_rules.purpose: generated targets out of step with their mapped sources
severity_rules.limits: Covers only targets declared in docs/.doc-sync-map.yaml; prose that mirrors code by hand is not seen.

severity_rules.description: Approved document with no content beyond its title.
severity_rules.purpose: approved documents with no content beyond the title
severity_rules.limits: Counts headings and words; a document full of filler still passes.

severity_rules.description: Draft document that is still a placeholder.
severity_rules.purpose: draft documents that are still placeholders
severity_rules.limits: Detects boilerplate/placeholder markers and emptiness, not a document that looks complete and says nothing.

severity_rules.description: Local link or relative path that does not resolve.
severity_rules.purpose: relative links and paths that do not resolve
severity_rules.limits: Markdown files only; links inside code blocks and generated text are not resolved, and external URLs are never fetched offline.

severity_rules.description: Private key marker committed into a text file.
severity_rules.purpose: private key markers committed into text files
severity_rules.limits: Pattern matches a key header only; other credentials are not detected, and names and locations are recorded, never values. Never baselined.

severity_rules.description: Instruction that depends on undocumented private knowledge.
severity_rules.purpose: instructions that depend on undocumented private knowledge
severity_rules.limits: Markdown only, and only known phrase patterns such as "ask John" or "just ask"; undocumented knowledge in any other form is not seen.

severity_rules.description: Critical human-owned document past its review date.
severity_rules.purpose: critical human-owned documents past their review date
severity_rules.limits: Uses declared review dates; a stale but frequently-read document that was never reviewed on schedule still fails.

severity_rules.description: Non-critical human-owned document past its review date.
severity_rules.purpose: non-critical human-owned documents past their review date
advisory decisions that nobody owns or has dated
severity_rules.limits: Only [not_applicable] entries are inspected; the presence of an owner or a review date says nothing about whether the decision is still right.

sunset_note: End of life needs a deprecation policy, a pointer to the successor, and a tombstone page. A security contact is required by many policies but has no catalog type yet.
